we have derived compact expressions for one loop scattering amplitudes for four open string vector boson scattering in the presence of supersymmetric configurations of intersecting D-branes and magnetized D-brane on toroidal orbifold compactification.

we have derived a compact and efficient expression for one-loop open-string scattering amplitudes in the presence of D-branes, and that we have used these amplitudes to compute the total cross-section of open string scattering into closed string states, for the first time in a string theory setup.

the study of scattering amplitudes at the string scale, with a view to their phenomenological implications for future colliders.
the study of string scattering amplitudes in the context of intersecting or magnetised D-brane models.
the study of string scattering amplitudes and their applications to phenomenology.
